observation: Bottom floating dock visibly overlaps lower area of featured card and carousel controls at one scroll position.

observation: Search source picker shows 3 selected while edge chip is cut; the horizontal affordance is weak.

observation: 138 saved vs 136 automatic bucket; two items might be system collection, excluded states, or a data issue.

observation: Provider labels show mixed capitalization across Library/Explore/Schedule.

observation: The interface allows a day to be auto-picked or manually overridden; prediction/source semantics not confirmed.

observation: Hapus unduhan appears disabled alongside an offline storage figure of 0 MB; explanatory text is missing.
